update_name: Monument of Triumph (Destiny 2's final live-service update; patch 9.7.0)
launch_date: 2026-06-09 (Tuesday). Source: Bungie "Every End is a New Beginning" (5/21/26) + all three Dev Insights; Aztecross TWAB confirms 6/9.
changes_overview: FINAL live-service update for D2 (patch 9.7.0). After this, no active development but game stays playable. Source: BUNGIE 'Every End is a New Beginning' (5/21).

Massive sandbox overhaul: 3 new aspects (Solar Titan Shieldburst, Solar Hunter Crackshot, Void Warlock Soul Siphon) bringing every non-Prismatic subclass to 4 aspects; new Void Hunter melee Phantom Surge; 2 new Darkness grenades (Stasis Shatter, Strand Slicewire). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + BUNGIE Abilities & Armor Insight.

Ward of Dawn fully reworked: 2x bigger 'Thunderdome', pulls/taunts enemies in, weakens enemies + buffs allies, repositionable up to 2x by throwing the core (core is a destructible weak point = PvP counterplay). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + xHOUNDISHx.

Armor 3.0 expansion: 6 NEW armor archetypes (Siegebreaker, Skirmisher, Demolitionist, Colossus, Reaver, Powerhouse) on top of original 6. ALL Armor 3.0 exotics retroactively get Tier 5 stats + access to all tuning mods (no re-grind). Ghost archetype mods now bias your chosen archetype to slots 1-2 (was 1-3) = easier targeted farming. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + BUNGIE.

Weapon Tier Upgrading: ANY tier-integrated weapon (incl. vault + crafted) can be upgraded toward Gear Tier 5 via a new mod socket for a cost; unlocks enhanced perks/mods/components + T5 cosmetics. Cannot ADD column perks, so god-roll chasing still matters. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Catalyst bonanza: 25 brand-new catalysts on weapons that had none + 9 perks added to old stat-only catalysts. Confirmed: Chaperone=Triple Tap, Parasite=Envious Arsenal, Tarrabah=Ambitious Assassin, Crimson=To the Pain, Merciless=Heal Clip. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Artifacts 2.0: anti-Champion baked into EVERY weapon's intrinsic frame (no artifact column, fires immediately on landing shots). SEVEN artifacts from past seasons available at once + 6 new mods. Disabled in Comp/Trials. Saves in loadouts. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Big philosophy shift: ability uptime ceiling cut and super-from-boss-damage cut to push weapons back into the 50/50 split; offset by across-the-board Primary + Special weapon buffs. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + BUNGIE.

Pantheon 2.0 as a permanent activity (new boss roster), SRL returns permanently, Gambit becomes 'Gambit Ops', Director returns to center of UI, Onslaught/Coil/Contest rebalanced, raid+dungeon loot all brought to modern Tier parity with set bonuses. Source: BUNGIE 'Every End'.

Attune Anywhere: attunement now in your inventory (one weapon per activity type) for much higher targeted drop rates; vendors get Rep Rank reward tracks restored + huge focusing expansion. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
buffs: PRIMARY WEAPONS buffed across the board in PvE: Legendary primaries +30% vs base combatants, Exotic primaries 30%->40% vs base, non-blaster primaries +15% vs elites, blaster primaries 15%->20% vs elites. Bows additionally +20% base / +40% elite. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

SPECIAL WEAPONS: most get +20% vs elites (excludes snipers, rocket pulses, rocket sidearms, swords, Choir of One). Fusion rifles +7-20% by frame; shotguns +15-20%; slug shotguns +5-10%; snipers +10-15%; trace rifles +20% base/+20% elite (exotic traces 30%->40% base). Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
HEAVY: LFRs +10% vs bosses/champs (Precision +10% scalar, +~30% reserves); heavy GLs & rockets +5% vs boss/champ; crossbows +10% vs boss/champ. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Anarchy buffed: trap lifetime 10s->15s (+50%), trap damage +30%, detonation damage doubled, gains Impromptu Ammunition (replaces Moving Target). Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
The Lament: previous nerf reverted by ~70%, returning final-combo damage + self-heal = strong single-target again. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Vex Mythoclast: intrinsic now stronger Rewind-Rounds-like full-auto; LFR precision kills trigger ignition + full reload on swap; catalyst procs on sustained damage too. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Arbalest +33% vs Champions; Divinity Penance +20% dmg, faster activation (4s->3s), cage in 10 shots (was 14); Heirloom +20% charged impact / +20% vs miniboss+champ / +10% vs boss + Incandescent catalyst. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Jade Rabbit, Touch of Malice, MIDA, Tarrabah, Truth, Wardcliff Coil (max ammo 5->8), Xenophage (+10 reserves), Slayer's Fang, Prometheus Lens, Centrifuse, Hierarchy of Needs all buffed/reworked. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Stasis survivability up: Frost Armor stacks now melt 1-at-a-time (not all at once) = much higher uptime; max-stack DR 31%->35%; all Stasis subclasses make Shatter Shards intrinsically (no Harvest aspect needed); taking damage while Frost Armor grants ability energy. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Many multi-charge / 100%-damage ability buffs: Stormcaller Chain Lightning & Striker Seismic Strike/Shield Bash & Sunbreaker Hammer Strike +100% vs combatants; several melees now 2 charges; Glacial Quake (already top super) gets MORE AoE damage; numerous aspects gain a 3rd fragment slot. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Class-ability-damage aspects now scale with class stat over 100 (Shieldburst, Crackshot, Ascension, Threaded Spectre, Drinker's Lash suspend wave, etc.). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Exotic armor reworks/buffs: Wormhusk (built-in cure loop), Shards of Galanor (Tcrash-tier super dmg), Caliban's Hand, Frostees, Star-Eater-tier Matadoxia (=Cuirass Thundercrash), Skull of Dire Ahamkara (double Nova + Nova Lance combo), Helm of Saint-14 reworked into Ward synergy, Pyrogale, Stoicism/Spirit of Star-Eater for Twilight Arsenal 25%->50%, Pra/Praefectus(+500% melee), No Backup Plans now works on non-Void, Mantle of Battle Harmony, Crown of Tempests, Astrocyte Verse, Dawn Chorus. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Ariana's Vow (Eyasluna) hand cannon damage bonus up to 4.5x. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Older damage perks buffed: Focused Fury 20%->25% (easier to proc), Full Court & Lasting Impression 25%->35%, Reservoir Burst 25%->30%, Adagio on shotguns/bows 20%->30%. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
nerfs: ROCKET PULSE RIFLES hit hard: -10% PvE damage, additional -25% vs bosses (stacks to ~-35% on bosses), -25% explosion radius, -15 ammo gen stat, super gen -25% (roamers)/-33% (standard). The 'double special' rocket-pulse-fueling bug is fixed. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
SUPER energy regen from dealing damage to BOSSES reduced by 60% (kills super-spam DPS phases; can no longer farm super mid-DPS). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

ABILITY STAT ceiling cut: max passive cooldown bonus from ability stats reduced 20%; max ability cooldown bonus 190%->125%. Floor unchanged, ceiling lowered to stop ability-spam trivializing combat. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Lucky Pants: bonus damage vs bosses reduced by 33% (pushed out of boss-DPS role); Eya... note: Eriana's/Civil Discourse style outliers tuned — Civil Discourse (Uvalde-style) max bonus reduced to 2.5x. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Outbreak Perfected max Nanite bonus 4.5x->4x (because primaries buffed across board). Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Thunderlord: lightning-strike ammo refund 7->5 (boss-DPS line-up tuning). Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Sunshot & Graviton Lance explosions rebalanced — more damage up close, less at range (less encounter-wiping on one kill). Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Choir of One ammo nerfed (45->35 base, 90->70 enhanced) to follow standard rules; double-special add-clear nerf: special ammo meter gain from minors -17%. Adaptive Burst LFR crate ammo 5->3. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

PvP ability nerfs: multi-charge abilities now START a match with only 1 charge; Knockout no longer grants extra lunge vs players; Golden Gun Deadshot super energy from player kills -40%; Scatter grenade chase distance vs players -50%; Mobius Quiver crossbow buff -50%. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

PvP exotic/grenade safety nerfs: Feedback Fence no longer gives melee DR vs players; Controverse handheld supernova energy return -50% (+ chunk bug fix); Tommy... Dameon (D.A.R.C.I.-fusion) recovery window 0.1s->0.3s; Nothing Manacles scatter seekers 4->3 + no self-chaining; Behemoth Diamond Lance freeze radius reduced vs players. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Grapple melee vs bosses: max grapple-melee bonus from grenade stat -50% and now additive (not multiplicative) with melee stat. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Set-bonus nerfs: Smoke Jumper 2pc 'Ride Together Die Together' DR 50%->40%. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + xHOUNDISHx.
Spark/Facet jolt-from-construct (Arc Soul/Onyx Sentry) now has a 4s internal cooldown. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Whisper of Rending... Whisper Rime: max Frost Armor stacks 8->7 (rescaled to keep same max benefit). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Crucible-only: Special/Heavy/Super kill point-gains -33%, Glaive melee gains -20%; Praxic Blade & sword infinite-block ammo economy tightened. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
pve_meta_forecast: Expect a WEAPON-forward DPS meta: with super-from-boss-damage -60% and ability ceiling cut, raid/dungeon damage shifts away from super-spam toward sustained weapon damage. Plan rotations with heavy weapons + DPS exotics, not 6x super yeets. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Primary weapons become genuinely viable in endgame (big across-board PvE buffs) — primaries + the new Anti-Champion-on-every-gun system mean you can run your favorite guns and still stun champs. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

LFRs look strong for boss DPS (Precision +10% scalar, +10% vs boss/champ, +~30% reserves, more ammo per brick). Anarchy returns as a top trap/DPS heavy. The Lament back as top single-target sword. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Rocket Pulse Rifles fall OUT of the boss-DPS meta (heavy nerfs) — pivot away from them for damage phases. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Stasis becomes a top survivability/add-clear pick: 1-at-a-time Frost Armor decay, intrinsic Shatter Shards, 35% DR, new Stasis Shatter grenade (also stuns Unstoppables again). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Super-damage exotics rebalanced upward (Shards of Galanor, Matadoxia, Star-Eater Twilight Arsenal 50%, Skull of Dire Ahamkara double-Nova) — these become the go-to single-cast burst options now that you can't chain supers. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

New build-battle/experimentation window: 7 artifacts + new aspects + new archetypes = wide-open theorycrafting for the game's final stretch (Aztecross: 'build battles about to go hard'). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
NEEDS CONFIRMATION: exact top-DPS rotations / numerical tier list — full patch notes drop 6/9; no source ranks specific top-3 DPS setups yet.
pvp_meta_forecast: Ability spam reduced at match start (multi-charge abilities start with 1 charge) = more gunfight-centric early engagements. New 'Arena' playlist is gunplay-focused old-school PvP. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + BUNGIE 'Every End'.

Hunters look very strong in PvP: new aggressive Phantom Surge phase-melee, Crackshot burst, Acrobat's Dodge usable airborne, smoke now grants invis on deploy by default. Aztecross repeatedly flags Hunters as oppressive. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Titans gain map-control tools: repositionable Ward of Dawn (move zones, pull enemies), Shieldburst barricade (sliding + remote C4 detonation), Striker Thruster usable airborne. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Several long-standing PvP frustration picks nerfed: Feedback Fence melee DR removed, Dameon/D... fusion safe-kill window widened cost, Controverse handheld supernova, Scatter grenade tracking, Nothing Manacles, Diamond Lance freeze radius, Golden Gun kill-feed snowball. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Void invisibility made more visible in Crucible (counterable); Warlock He Rises now lowers enemy accuracy but no longer boosts initial glide burst. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Artifact disabled in Comp & Trials = flatter, skill-based ranked sandbox. Glass Cannon (D1 balance) and 'Software' third-person-abilities private modes added. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight + 'Every End'.
NEEDS CONFIRMATION: specific PvP weapon/HC meta winners — primary/HC base-damage micro-tweaks exist but no source calls a definitive top PvP loadout pre-launch.
priority_weapons_catalysts: Anarchy — get it and level it; major buff makes it a top trap/DPS heavy again. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
The Lament — re-acquire/level; ~70% nerf revert restores it as premier single-target sword. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Vex Mythoclast — meaningful PvE rework (ignitions, full-auto Rewind, easier catalyst). Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Precision Linear Fusion Rifles (incl. crafted/adept) — buffed dmg + big reserve/ammo-per-brick increase; prep for boss DPS. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Chase NEW catalysts: Chaperone (Triple Tap), Parasite (Envious Arsenal), Tarrabah (Ambitious Assassin) confirmed; 25 new + 9 upgraded catalysts total — start acquiring the host exotics now. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Arbalest (+33% vs Champions) and Divinity (buffed) for champion/debuff utility. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Crafted weapons: finish patterns now — all crafted legendaries get a Tier 1-5 upgrade path (enhanced perks/components/origins) on login. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Bows, fusion rifles, shotguns, snipers, trace rifles — broadly buffed special archetypes worth leveling. AVOID over-investing in Rocket Pulse Rifles (heavy boss-DPS nerf). Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Exotic Hand Cannon (dredgen-themed, from the Monument of Triumph rewards pass, originally planned for 'Shadow and Order') incoming — note as a launch chase. Source: xHOUNDISHx (confirmed by trailer); needs name confirmation.
priority_armor_exotics: You do NOT need to re-grind exotic armor: all Armor 3.0 exotics (everything since Edge of Fate) retroactively become Tier 5 stats with full tuning-mod access. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + xHOUNDISHx.

Prioritize exotics that got reworked into new loops: Wormhusk Crown (built-in cure), Shards of Galanor & Matadoxia & Skull of Dire Ahamkara (top super-burst), Helm of Saint-14 (new Ward synergy), Caliban's Hand, Frostees, Pyrogale, Mantle of Battle Harmony, Crown of Tempests, No Backup Plans (now non-Void). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Stasis exotics get strong with the Frost Armor rework: Frostees, Cadmus Ridge Lenslock, Blastwave... Blast Striders, Whisper Rime synergy. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
For Void Warlock Soul Siphon loop: Nezarec's Sin (new suppress synergy), Claws of Ahamkara, Necrotic, Winter's Helm. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
NOTE: collection-roll exotics are NOT auto-upgraded to T5 — only earned/equipped Armor 3.0 exotics. Re-pull from collections may need re-acquiring T5 stats. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
NEEDS CONFIRMATION: a single 'best exotic armor' per class — sources list many reworks but no definitive ranking pre-launch.
new_builds: Solar Titan 'Shieldburst' bomb-wall: charge barricade into a dead-messenger-style explosion; pairs with Tommy's Matchbook/Polaris (scorch stack), Arbor Warden, Hallowfire Heart, Khepri's Horn for instant ignitions; damage scales with class stat >100. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Solar Hunter 'Crackshot' gunslinger: mark 3 targets, dodge to fire flaming pistol shots, full hits cure you; combos with Radiant Dance Machines, Sixth Coyote, On Your Mark, Gunpowder Gamble; usable airborne. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Void Warlock 'Soul Siphon' vampire loop: powered-melee then drain enemies for damage + overshield + class energy; 2 melee charges baseline; pairs with Feed the Void (devour), Child of the Old Gods, Necrotic/Winter's Helm, Nezarec's Sin (suppress). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

Void Hunter aggression: Phantom Surge phase-melee + reworked Trapper's Ambush (now class-ability energy, grants devour on kills, heals, refreshes invis) for a back-to-back dive loop. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Repositionable Ward of Dawn zone-control build (move bubble across capture points; Helm of Saint-14 extends duration + Weapons of Light outside). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Stasis 'Frost Armor uptime' survivability builds (1-at-a-time decay, 35% DR, intrinsic shards, new Stasis Shatter grenade) across all classes. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Threadling-turret Warlock: Mindspun Invocation now spawns a world threadling NEST; synergizes with the exotic Strand LMG (surface-of-...) for an autonomous turret. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Strand Slicewire grenade damage build (4 whip lashes, severs) stacked with high Grenade stat; secret synergy with Mindspun Invocation. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.

New armor set bonuses to build around: Exodus Down/Nessus 'Emergency Electromagnets' (auto-collect orbs/ammo on shield break) + 'Repurpose Charge' (heal+DR on armor-charge gain/loss/spend); Throne World/Veritas 'Lucent Transmutation/Tithes' (elemental pickups + void moths on powerful finishers). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + xHOUNDISHx.
Experiment freely — Bungie/community team explicitly encourage weird weapon+armor mixes during the final stretch ('could be the next meta'). Source: Aztecross stream 2d.
fragments_note: No brand-new subclass FRAGMENTS were announced — the changes are new ASPECTS (Shieldburst, Crackshot, Soul Siphon), a new melee (Phantom Surge), 2 new grenades (Stasis Shatter, Strand Slicewire), and many aspects gaining an extra fragment SLOT (2->3). Note: Stasis Harvest aspects had fragment slots REDUCED 3->2. There ARE 6 new Artifact MODS (Fierce Proxemics, Blinding Jolts, Tazer Tag, Rapid Remedy, Precision Equity, Sticker Shock) plus 6 new armor ARCHETYPES — not fragments. Advice: you already have all fragments; focus on the new aspects/grenades and on re-evaluating fragment loadouts where slots changed. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
prep_before_update: DO NOT mass-delete armor before 6/9 — most legacy armor (event armor, class sets, raid sets) is being refreshed/refocusable; Aztecross explicitly warns 'don't go delete your vaults yet'. Confirm what's farmable post-patch first. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Finish weapon crafting patterns — all crafted legendaries gain a Tier 1-5 upgrade path on login; completing patterns now maximizes value. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Cash in Trials/seasonal engrams before launch (community team note: 'cash in those Trials engrams'). Source: Aztecross stream 2d.

Spend/stockpile upgrade currencies (enhancement cores/prisms, glimmer, ascendant materials) — Weapon Tier Upgrading costs resources to push weapons toward T5. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight (cost-based upgrade).

Acquire the exotic WEAPONS that are getting new catalysts now (Chaperone, Parasite, Tarrabah, Crimson, Merciless, etc.) so you can chase catalysts immediately at launch. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Note: Nightfall Ciphers auto-convert to Vanguard Ciphers at launch — no need to burn them in a panic. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Keep spoils of conquest — armor 2.0 raid pieces become focusable at Hawthorne for 10 spoils each (for raid mods); also used for adept re-rolls. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + deprioritized 8d TWID.
prioritize_now: Read the FULL 6/9 patch notes when they drop (Bungie warns it's a record-length 29,000+ word set) — many minor changes were omitted from the previews. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + xHOUNDISHx.
Finish crafting patterns and tidy your vault (without mass-deleting) so you're ready to upgrade weapons to T5 on day one. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Pre-acquire the exotic weapons that gain catalysts and the reworked exotic armors you want to build around. Source: BUNGIE + AZTECROSS.
Plan to pivot DPS loadouts AWAY from super-spam and Rocket Pulse Rifles toward weapon-centric rotations (LFRs, Anarchy, Lament, swords/heavies). Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + BUNGIE.
Set up your intended attunement targets mentally — at launch you can attune 1 weapon per activity type for much higher drop rates. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
farming: Catalysts (BEST farm at launch): 25 new + 9 upgraded catalysts go live 6/9 — old exotics finally get catalysts; this is the single biggest catalyst farming window in the game's history. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Tier 5 gear: activities remain the best/most consistent source of NATURAL Tier 5 weapons; focusing gives T3/T4 (upgradeable to T5). Armor focuses up to T5 directly (armor isn't weapon-upgradeable). Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.

Targeted armor archetype farming: Ghost archetype mods now bias your chosen archetype into slots 1-2 (was 1-3), and new combo archetypes drop from almost any Armor 3.0 source — easiest stat-targeting ever. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB.
Attune Anywhere: attune to your wanted weapon per activity type for greatly increased drop chance (free, unlimited swaps). Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Pantheon 2.0 (permanent) for high-tier rewards + reprised armor ornaments from original raids; full gauntlet 6/13, single-boss rotation 6/16. Source: BUNGIE 'Every End' + deprioritized 8d TWID.

Featured Raids/Dungeons (2 each weekly) reward the highest-quality tiered gear (deepsight weapons, T5 armor, adepts on master) — best power/loot farm; some lockouts weekly. Source: deprioritized 8d TWID.

Exotic ciphers/exotic drops + power: Vendor Rep Rank reward tracks are RESTORED (Shaxx, Zavala, Saint-14, Xur, Banshee, Drifter) — ranking up vendors again yields rewards; Xur stocks new catalysts + tiered armor. NEEDS CONFIRMATION on exact exotic-cipher source rates post-patch. Source: BUNGIE Weapons Insight.
Materials/spoils: raid armor 2.0 focusable at Hawthorne (10 spoils each); adept re-rolls cost spoils — bank spoils now. Source: AZTECROSS TWAB + deprioritized 8d TWID.
